title: Iteration speed: GPU queue wait, step-bench startup, cold compiles
gap_analysis: Warm 1-node step bench = ~4 min wall, of which ~40 s is measurement (engine start 30 s, dummy load 23 s, KV profile ~70 s, warmup ~70 s). The dominant delay is the GPU queue: 14 agents share 3 running 1-node holds; 1-GPU jobs wait 10-40 min, 4-GPU jobs 20-30 min.
plan: queue-wait analysis + fair packing in wsgpu.sh
persistent bench service / engine-free family microbench
extend pool to Hecate when login returns
